name: Koushinchou Shoujo ~XL na Kanojo wa H na Nayami de Ippai!
original_name: 高身長少女 ～XLな彼女はHな悩みでいっぱい！
source:
She is a very tall and beautiful girl.

It looks like she's going to reach the clouds .... She says I'll be catching her soon, but it's really impossible.
She is the biggest of the school, so she always catches the attention, she is nice, popular with boys and girls and most of all, she is really cool.

On the other hand, there is me, a lambda pupil, neither good nor bad at school, that nobody notices, which is not extraordinary ... Finally yes, in fact for a boy of my age (and even compared to a girl) I am ... Small.

But I know that in reality she is "weak" and that she is sick of it, that she hates everything of herself, of all that stands out the most.

Because she's my childhood friend ...

As much she got older, much she gradually lost her mouth.

One day, took a sudden momentum, I confess all my love to her. And ...

"Iyo ..." (Yes ...)

... A positive answer came to me.
